method.unit: A slot is a materially distinct situation the atlas claims it should be able to express. Slots are not Cartesian products.

status.covered: The registry has a direct structured representation and at least one usable path through it.
status.partial: The subject is mentioned or structurally representable, but lacks a complete case, evidence, outcome, or agency path.
status.absent: No canonical entity or scenario directly represents the slot.

priority_targets.reason: entry.path × cohort.state has 0/45 observed authored combinations.
evidence.level × evidence.role has 0/42 observed authored combinations.
arrangement is thin: 2/6 values touched across 5 source(s).
scenario.downlevelling_trap explicitly marks arrangement as unknown: Down-levelling and delayed starts can occur in permanent, contract, or contract-to-hire arrangements.
cohort.state is thin: 1/5 values touched across 1 source(s).
scenario.closed_then_reposted explicitly marks cohort.state as unknown: Internal-fill is compatible, but the scenario explicitly excludes proving that someone was already chosen.
entry.path is thin: 2/9 values touched across 8 source(s).
scenario.ats_knockout explicitly marks entry.path as unknown: The observations combine outreach and rejection; the scenario does not say whether the candidate applied inbound.
